crime_highlights: Mr. Alfred, an Indigenous man, was a friend of the victim's older brothers, and to a certain degree, a family friend.
He was 26 years of age at the time of the offence and the victim, herself Indigenous, was 13.
He engaged in sexual intercourse with her on at least two occasions
rationale_highlights: I must take account of this man's background and circumstances as they reflect quite regrettable experiences growing up as an Aboriginal person
I am also concerned that the sentence this Court imposes does not have a destructive effect upon him
Those considerations call for restraint in the sentencing process
it must be tempered and restrained to address the concerns I have articulated
the judge considered the appellant's history as an Indigenous person
note: Crime narrative is thin; victim effects not described.

crime_highlights: Ms. Graham was convicted on August 27, 2019, of possessing a Schedule I substance (methamphetamine) for the purpose of trafficking
the appellant was arrested at the Stadium SkyTrain station with a small clear baggie containing 2.25 grams of methamphetamine in her hand
A search of her purse found: a) nine clear plastic baggies of methamphetamine
rationale_highlights: Ms. Graham has lived a life marked by trauma
She has suffered badly, and faced many barriers as an obviously transgendered woman
Ms. Graham's particular personal circumstances justify the imposition of a sentence below the range that would otherwise apply
a further custodial sentence would be disproportionate
note: Factor is transgender marginalization and trauma, not racism; no victim effects.

crime_highlights: On December 2 the appellant was inside a residence terrorizing the owners with a shotgun
He fled with items from the residence including a laptop, two rifles, two shotguns, and ammunition.
He drove towards two unmarked police vehicles and appeared to be attempting to carjack vehicles.
he produced a shotgun and fired in the direction of the police
Fortunately, neither the officers nor their vehicles were hit by the shots.
rationale_highlights: This remains the case despite Mr. Sellars' mental-health difficulties and Gladue factors. But for those factors, the sentence I am about to impose would have been even higher.
The judge expressly found the appellant's moral blameworthiness to be reduced because of his mental health difficulties and the Gladue factors
focusing on the trauma he and his extended family had experienced as a result of the intergenerational effects of the residential school system
